Add Healthcare Expenditure Share of Income

Source: R/add_expenditure_healthcare_share_income.R
add_expenditure_healthcare_share_income.Rd

Calculates the share of infrequent healthcare expenditure relative to total household income, normalising both to the same recall period, and flags households with catastrophic health care spending.

This is a convenience wrapper around add_expenditure_type_share_income() with fixed parameters for the health expenditure module: expenditure recall period is 180 days (6 months), income recall period is 30 days, and the catastrophic threshold is 0.25 (25%).

Prerequisite: run add_expenditure_type_zero_infreq() before calling this function. cm_income_total must also be present in df, either directly from the survey or via add_income_source_prop().

Usage

add_expenditure_healthcare_share_income(
  df,
  expenditure_type = "cm_expenditure_infrequent_health",
  total_income = "cm_income_total"
)

Arguments

df

A data frame.

expenditure_type

Column name for infrequent health expenditure amount.

total_income

Column name for total household income.

Value

A data frame with two additional columns:

  • cm_expenditure_infrequent_health_share_income: Recall-normalised health expenditure share of income; 1 for zero-income households with health expenditure above 0; NA if income or expenditure is NA.

  • cm_expenditure_infrequent_health_share_income_d: 1L if catastrophic (share >= 0.25), 0L if not (or for a zero-income household with zero health expenditure), NA_integer_ if income or share is NA.

ANA indicator

Metric ID MET169 (legacy indicator ID IND176).

See also

Other expenditure_share_income: add_expenditure_type_share_income(), add_expenditure_water_share_income()

Examples

df <- data.frame(
  cm_expenditure_infrequent_health = c(60, 0, 30),
  cm_income_total = c(100, 200, 0)
)
add_expenditure_healthcare_share_income(df)
#>   cm_expenditure_infrequent_health cm_income_total
#> 1                               60             100
#> 2                                0             200
#> 3                               30               0
#>   cm_expenditure_infrequent_health_share_income
#> 1                                           0.1
#> 2                                           0.0
#> 3                                           1.0
#>   cm_expenditure_infrequent_health_share_income_d
#> 1                                               0
#> 2                                               0
#> 3                                               1
